wiring.finding: startInterceptor installs setupAccountEntityTriggers after Mongo connection and before the startup callback.
Account save middleware calls the replaceable accountSchema.postSave.
Loop save middleware calls the replaceable loopSchema.postSave.

Installed Account postSave schedules AccountUpdated with termsAccepted and other account fields via setImmediate; next() proceeds without awaiting send. Synchronous construction errors and rejected sends are logged.
Installed Loop postSave schedules LoopUpdated via setImmediate; next() proceeds without awaiting send. Synchronous construction errors and rejected sends are logged.
AcceptTerms updates termsAccepted and saves the Account, reaching the installed AccountUpdated hook in a started service.
ClearRobot reaches remove/_remove, which clears the robot association, soft-deletes and saves the Loop, reaching its installed LoopUpdated hook.

supersedes: The earlier controller/default-schema-only review left these outer hooks unrecovered; treating that scope as proof of no AccountUpdated or LoopUpdated would be incorrect.
limits: Actual EventSender serialization, SNS/provider delivery and HTTP timing are not executed by this source review.
Hooks are conditional on startup wiring and document save; they do not imply events for pure reads or direct database updates.
